name: [ CHAPTER 2 ] Winx - The Fairy Guardians
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Winx – The Fairy Guardians! 🧚‍♀️✨


This is a story-driven school roleplay game where you enroll as a Fairy!

Choose Bloom or create your own OC student.
👗 Customize & dress your character with hundreds of options
🏫 Attend classes to get experience & butterflies.
⚔️ Fight creatures and complete boss battles.
🔓 Unlock Stella, Flora, Musa, Tecna, and Aisha by leveling up.

🌈 Unlock Magic Winx & Charmix on each character.
🏠 Explore the campus and roleplay with your friends.

Credits to SEPROPHIM for the loading screen

scripts.title: Winx The fairy guardians
scripts.features:
Please join the discord server for inquiring about the features. Please don't be afraid to seek out to my discord: starlightsbutterfly

This script feature includes 
= -----------------------
= Portal Tab ------------
 lets you teleport to areas/places without restriction.
= -----------------------
= Quest Tab ------------
A paragraph provided for the user to know information about their given quests. This also includes a start quest button which is self explanatory.
Alongside provided is also a Quest completor, Which is also self explanatory.
= -----------------------
= Activity Tab ------------
Inside the activity tab is a paragraph provided for what activity is currently happening. There are also provided sections per classes to complete it automatically! 

Please keep in mind that this script is in beta, which there are may be changes in the future.
